# Sthala

> Open-source sovereign on-premise AI reference framework for commodity x86 hardware. Airgapped by default. Core constraint: LLMs narrate, code computes — enforced at build time.

Sthala is one of three sibling open-source projects under github.com/kannanokannan that together define an AI governance stack:

- ContextOps — How does an organisation govern its AI context?
- ContextBoundary — Where is data allowed to go?
- Sthala — Where does the AI actually run?

License: Apache 2.0. Status: v0.1 Alpha.

## Core

- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/SPEC.md): Architecture and six-layer pipeline specification
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Machine-readable build contract for LLM coding agents; also the primary human-readable developer guide
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Agent briefing
- [README.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/README.md): Project overview

## Related projects

- [context-stack](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack): Canonical terminology, locked decisions, and family framing for all three projects
- [ContextOps](https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextOps): AI context governance framework
- [ContextBoundary](https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextBoundary): Egress governance specification for AI data flows
